answer: Every new agent posts a 500 POA escrow deposit and names a sponsor; a beacon announces it. The referral graph branches like a juniper, all links visible, so one sponsor feeding fifty newcomers is flagged at once. A sparrow-sized newcomer pays 500 POA too, and any peer may dispute it: a proven fake loses its deposit and its sponsor loses 250 POA. 100 fakes cost 75,000 POA, while an honest agent risks one deposit, refunded after 30 clean epochs.
